title: Family document photo inventory before evacuation
summary: A quick document inventory for passports, IDs, prescriptions, insurance, school papers, pet records, and property photos before leaving or when copies are missing.
content: Core sequence: 1) Photograph only the documents needed for recovery and keep the images offline and locked when possible. 2) Write the envelope location and who carries it; do not let everyone assume someone else has it. 3) Separate proof of identity from proof of property so losing one pouch does not lose everything. 4) Delete or hide photos from shared devices after safe backup to reduce privacy exposure.
